title: Retro with no commitments
why: The false-positive test. A summarizer asked for action items will invent some, because the prompt implies they exist. The correct answer is zero.
transcript:
Meera: Quick retro. What went well?
Adit: The release was smooth. No rollbacks.
Priya: Agreed, staging held up this time.
Tom: The design handoff felt better than last sprint.
Meera: What didn't?
Sana: Support volume spiked on Wednesday and we didn't know why until Thursday.
Rahul: Latency has been rough this month generally.
Adit: Yeah, it's been noticeable.
Meera: Fair. Anything else?
Tom: Not from me.
Meera: Good, that's it.

expected.notes: Every line is observation or opinion. Nobody accepts anything, nothing is assigned, no fork is closed.
